links.outcome: Correlation of automatic metrics with cardiologist ratings and sensitivity to changed measurement numbers
links.effect: Automatic-human metric correlations were fair to modest (best RadGraph F1 vs clinical utility r = 0.42); automatic metrics showed only 0-5% drop when measurement numbers were changed.
links.quote: automatic metrics showed insensitivity (0-5% drop) to changes in measurement numbers

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning open-source LLMs (QLoRA) versus in-context learning for echo report summarization

screen.reason: The study evaluates fine-tuned and prompted LLMs for echocardiography report impression generation using automated metrics and qualitative review by cardiologists, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard comparison.
